name: mirage
text: Tennis matching: it isn't failing. I asked Novig's own catalog just now: it lists exactly one live tennis game (ATP Challenger, Jong @ Wolf) and WTA none, and that one is matched. The other live match isn't on Novig at all, so there is nothing to pair it with. More will match as Novig lists more; I'll keep checking. Sockets: all four on the engine are live right now: BoltOdds lines, Kalshi, SharpAPI (Pinnacle prices) and SX Bet. The live lane prices from SharpAPI's Pinnacle line only, because that is the sharp price; BoltOdds, Kalshi and SX don't carry Pinnacle, so using them as the price would be less accurate. They can serve as a second opinion and as score sources, and I'm treating that as the next build (CH58d). Props on BoltOdds are not live (lines only).
